overloads.semanticRole: The Get edited text command is mainly to be used with the On After Edit form event to retrieve the text as it is being entered.

constraints: Behavior depends on the calling form event: during On Before Keystroke returns the text as it was before the last keystroke; during On After Keystroke or On After Edit returns the text including the last character entered.
Returns an empty string when used outside of a text-entry form-object context.
